scope: Original-engine diagnostic of the tutorial wall; not full tutorial acceptance.
observations: Before playback, bricks occupy the opening.
Five seconds after unpausing playback, bricks lie on the floor and the opening is clear visually.
After two seconds of ordinary forward input, Player X is 352.47; full crossing beyond X550 was not measured.
GetDestroyed is still zero: collapse does not require SetDestroyed or the original quest script.

asset_findings.description: Brick translations mainly shift sideways; rotation tracks turn around Z. Root and NonAccum transforms are identity. No authored collapse-to-floor transform track was found.
asset_findings.comparison: Prison secret wall has mass-zero keyframed bodies with the same collision flags; do not release all keyframed objects indiscriminately.

implementation_requirement: Provide physical motion for the animated positive-mass wall bodies, preserve render/collision agreement and save/load state, and prove ordinary-input traversal. Do not replace collapse with disabled collision.
limits: The exact native handoff frame and internal dispatch were not measured.
Native setup used console commands and a restored preexisting save.
Original-game screenshots are local proprietary-content evidence, not committed assets.
This observation does not prove fork traversal, combat, or full sewer escape.
